values.note: Campspot sells 67 RV sites: 23 Full Hookup RV (to 50 ft), 20 Full Hookup Buddy sites, 8 Full Hookup on the playground and 4 by the pond (to 42 ft), 6 water/electric sites (to 35 ft, only 2 of them 23 ft or longer) and 6 Extended Stay full-hookup sites with a 30-night minimum. Some sites are pull-through.

values.note: Book on Campspot or with the office; a reservation takes one night's deposit. 'There is a 3 night Minimum for all Holidays, and Tulip Time Festival.' Cancellations 15+ days out are refunded less $25. RV check-in after 1 pm, check-out 11 am.

note: Family campground opened in August 1969 in a gravel pit dug for the highway, and run by three generations of the Riemersma family.  It has a fishing pond with boat rentals, a pool (added in 1975), a rec room, an activity field, a playground and PumpkinFest, and rents cabins.  Rustic pop-up sites take stays of a week at most, and clubs are welcome. --Claude
summary: Operator site live (rates $48-52, season April 1 - November 1, both as stored; fees and season left as checked 2026-10-13).
